P: Serve the mains when Janet and the gang sit down at the strange quantum realm restaurant.
S: Scott's book signing coffee and cookies
Scott enjoying free coffee and fame in San Francisco
Chocolate chip cookies baked at 180C for 10 minutes, served with small cups of coffee.
the strange creatures of the quantum realm
Broccolini, purple carrots and radishes roasted with honey and chilli, served with a green herb dip.

Choux pastry of butter, water, flour and eggs beaten with gruyère, piped into small balls and baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow. Bring 250ml water, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until it forms a ball. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and a pinch of cayenne. Pipe 24 small balls onto lined trays, sprinkle with a little extra cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed, golden and hollow.
M: Lord Krylar's restaurant in the quantum realm
Strange-looking but tasty: purple rice of black rice cooked with coconut, topped with grilled chicken and pickled vegetables.

Fish, prawns and mussels in a tomato and white wine broth with garlic and fennel, with sourdough. Soften 1 onion, 1 fennel bulb and 4 garlic cloves in olive oil for 8 minutes. Add a pinch of chilli, 150ml white wine and bubble 2 minutes, then a 400g tin crushed tomatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer 15 minutes. Add 400g firm white fish in chunks and 8 green king prawns for 3 minutes, then 500g mussels, cover and cook until they open, about 4 minutes. Finish with basil and serve with toasted sourdough rubbed with garlic.
W: everything shrinking and growing in the quantum realm
One batch of vanilla batter baked as mini cupcakes and one giant cupcake at 175C, all iced with red buttercream and served together.
K: Blue butterfly pea tea poured over lemonade so it swirls purple in the glass.

s.n: Scott's book signing coffee and cookies
s.note: Scott enjoying free coffee and fame in San Francisco
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and an egg. Mix in 225g flour and 150g dark chocolate chips. Roll into balls and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Serve warm with small cups of freshly brewed coffee at the signing table.

s.note: the strange creatures of the quantum realm
s.how: Halve 2 bunches of broccolini, purple carrots and radishes and toss with oil, honey and chilli flakes. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes until charred at the edges. Blend herbs into Greek yoghurt for a green dip and serve the strange colours on a dark plate.

m.note: Lord Krylar's restaurant in the quantum realm
m.how: Simmer 300g black rice in 400ml coconut milk and water for 35 minutes until tender. Grill 800g chicken thighs and slice. Quickly pickle shredded carrot and red cabbage in rice vinegar with sugar. Serve the chicken on the purple rice with the pickles.

w.note: everything shrinking and growing in the quantum realm
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake half as mini cupcakes for 12 minutes and half as one giant cupcake for 40 minutes at 175C. Ice all of them with red buttercream made with icing sugar.

d.how: Steep 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 500ml boiling water for 5 minutes, strain and chill until deep blue. Fill 4 glasses with ice and 150ml lemonade each, then pour the blue tea over and watch it swirl purple. Add a squeeze of lemon.
